fair_warning.title: Fair Warning
fair_warning.text: Defeat the Royal Emissary three times during a single playthrough of “Curtain Call.”

first_steps.title: First Steps
first_steps.text: Interview the following VIPs in “The Last King”:

crashing_the_party.title: Crashing the Party
crashing_the_party.text: Defeat the [[Lunatic]] version of Dianne Devine in “The Last King.”

for_prying_eyes.title: For Prying Eyes
for_prying_eyes.text: Add the Hidden Library to the victory display in “Echoes of the Past.”

cuckoos_nest.title: The Cuckoo's Nest
cuckoos_nest.text: Resign with Daniel Chesterfield under an investigator’s control in “The Unspeakable Oath.”

guessing_game.title: Guessing Game
guessing_game.text: Advance to the final agenda of one agenda deck before advacing the first agenda of the other agenda deck in “Black Stars Rise.”

hastur_made_me_do_it.title: Hastur Made Me Do It
hastur_made_me_do_it.text: Defeat Hastur in “Dim Carcosa” while a Possession treachery is in your hand.

say_my_name.title: Say My Name
say_my_name.text: After you have heeded Daniel’s warning, speak the name of HASTUR aloud seven or more times during a single scenario (or its setup).

get_back_here.title: Get Back Here
get_back_here.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign having never ended a scenario with The Man in the Pallid Mask in play

path_is_false.title: The Path is False
path_is_false.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Doubt.

path_is_real.title: The Path is Real
path_is_real.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Conviction.

path_is_mine.title: The Path is Mine
path_is_mine.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with less than 2 Doubt and Conviction in total.

ptc_line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
ptc_line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

carcosa_expertise.title: Carcosa Expertise
carcosa_expertise.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign on Expert difficulty.
